reviews.comment: I took Dr. Walsh for 322 and 422, she was much easier in 322 but I took it during an online semester so our exams were open note. Overall she is a great professor and I got A's in both classes. The final in 422 was hard but 2 days before the final we asked if we could take it in groups and she let us - so she's a really chill prof

Dr. Walsh is very kind and helpful. The workload outside of class is a bit tedious, but it isn't hard. Each week we would watch lecture videos prior to coming into class. Then class time was used to go over practice problems. Coding projects are hard but can be done in a group. Hwk questions come straight from practice done in class. She's cool!!

Dr. Walsh is just a plain mediocre prof. The number of assignments is ridiculous, 4 tests, 5 projects, and 7 homeworks. There is something due every week and it just bogs you down. The other bad thing is coding in class is terrible, I would rather do it on my own. She grades really hard too. She is nice though and cares about her students.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Walsh is nice but has an odd teaching style. I despise how she forces us to code in class because she goes VERY FAST and you end up getting left in the dust and wasting whole classes trying to figure out why your code doesn't work and not learning any new material. The material isn't super hard but she doesn't make it easy on you to do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects
